title: Migration Regulations 1994
converter: cth_convert_sym_v5n.py (a copy of docx_text() and the volume joining of the workbench converter harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py that also maps Symbol-font and private-use characters, and writes out Word automatic bullets drawn in the Symbol font; kept outside the repository); the first deposit used p2au_cth_fetch.py (same conversion as workbench harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py): word/document.xml paragraphs one per line, table-of-contents paragraphs dropped, Chapter/Part/Division headings as '	Part N — Title'; multi-volume compilations joined with repeated front matter removed

reconverted_2026_11_07.previous_converter: p2au_cth_fetch.py (same conversion as workbench harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py), the converter of the 2026-10-20 deposit
reconverted_2026_11_07.source_docx_note: the four Word volumes of F2026C01017 (volume sha256s as listed above); same compilation and same download sha256 as the first deposit
reconverted_2026_11_07.why: docx_text() dropped characters Word writes as Symbol-font w:sym elements and kept Symbol text typed as private-use code points. cth_convert_sym_v5.py maps them to Unicode (Symbol F0B0 °, F0B7 •, F0BC … and the like); run with its mapping switched off it reproduces the first deposit byte for byte.
reconverted_2026_11_07.what_changed: Reconverted from the same Word files; a diff against the first deposit shows only these lines changed (same 54,423 lines, 19 characters more): lines 2147-2148, the two bullets (Symbol F0B7 -> •) of the note to reg 2.07AK(1); lines 7273, 7276 and 7279, three degree signs (private-use U+F0B0 -> °) in reg 5.15C(2) ('north of latitude 21° south', '23° south', '16° south'); line 27335, the dotted signature line of Form 2 (Search warrant) in Schedule 10, 14 Symbol ellipses (F0BC -> …) before 'Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner [or Delegate]'.
reconverted_2026_11_07.encodings_affected: none: the subject has no encodings, and the Migration Act 1958 encodings that cite this deposit (baseline-2026-10, baseline-2026-11) do not rely on the changed lines
reconverted_2026_11_07.note_2026_11_08: Incomplete: this list missed eight Symbol bullets that Word draws from automatic numbering (numbering.xml), which cth_convert_sym_v5.py did not read; restored on 2026-11-08, see reconverted_2026_11_08.

reconverted_2026_11_08.previous_converter: cth_convert_sym_v5.py (kept outside the repository), the converter of the 2026-11-07 reconversion
reconverted_2026_11_08.source_docx_note: the same four Word volumes of F2026C01017; same download sha256
reconverted_2026_11_08.why: An independent check found that F2026C01017VOL02.docx has eight auto-numbered paragraphs (numId 25, level 0) whose bullet is defined in numbering.xml as Symbol F0B7. The text has no w:sym element there, so cth_convert_sym_v5.py did not restore them. cth_convert_sym_v5n.py is v5 plus Word automatic bullets drawn in the Symbol font, written as the mapped character and a tab. These are the only numbered paragraphs in the four volumes, and no paragraph takes numbering from its style. With mapping off the converter still reproduces the first deposit byte for byte (8a05f2fc...).
reconverted_2026_11_08.what_changed: Reconverted from the same Word files. A diff against the 2026-11-07 text shows only these eight lines changed, each now starting with a bullet and a tab (same 54,423 lines, 16 characters more): lines 21148-21151 and 21228-21231, the two lists of visas in the Schedule 2 Subclass 489 criteria ('a Skilled—Independent Regional ... (Class UX) visa; ... a Subclass 487 (Skilled—Regional Sponsored) visa.'). The Symbol characters of the original are now all restored: 10 bullets, 3 degree signs and 14 ellipses.
reconverted_2026_11_08.encodings_affected: none: the subject has no encodings, and the Migration Act 1958 encodings that cite this deposit do not cite Schedule 2 Subclass 489 or rely on the changed lines
